universal_lens: The Trench Funnel unifies biophysical drag, roster attrition, and microstructural pricing into a single Bayesian state-transition operator. It models how localized perturbations in air density and personnel availability cascade through the game-script manifold, ultimately converging on an updated posterior probability for market outcomes.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps this by treating Kalshi prints as the Layer-1 prior. Environmental (air density) and tracking (RYOE) data act as independent likelihood functions. A conformal damping heuristic is applied to prevent overfitting when empirical priors are sparse, yielding a robust posterior log-odds shift.
gse_mapping: GSE translates these primitives into real-time situational reasoning: wind vectors alter deep-pass success probabilities, while trench tracking metrics (Stacked Box %) dictate immediate run/pass play-calling transitions. Injury statuses dynamically reweight the available action space for both offensive and defensive schemes.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Trench Funnel operates as a multi-layered Bayesian filter. We begin with a robust Layer-1 prior derived from market confluence (Kalshi vs. De-vigged books). This establishes our baseline probability manifold. Next, we introduce environmental perturbations via the Atmospheric Drag Operator. The measured air density and wind speed at Lambeau Field create a deterministic shift in the expected value of deep-ball attempts, effectively altering the payoff matrix for passing plays. Simultaneously, the Trench Separation Kernel utilizes high-frequency tracking data (RYOE, Stacked Box %) to quantify the degradation of the offensive line's spatial dominance. When combined with injury availability shifts (e.g., Monk, Banks), these tracking metrics force a dynamic re-evaluation of the game script. If the trenches collapse (negative RYOE), the offense is mathematically forced into passing states, which then interact multiplicatively with the atmospheric drag constraints. The final posterior is not merely an aggregation but a constrained optimization across physical, personnel, and market dimensions. The heuristic damping applied in the absence of a dense empirical pair-matrix ensures we do not overstate the magnitude of these L2 signals, preserving epistemic humility.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits from mid-20th century stochastic weather modeling, where atmospheric variables were first integrated into ballistic trajectories. It later absorbed the efficient market hypothesis from financial mathematics, utilizing independent liquidity pools to establish priors. Most recently, it integrates modern computer vision and spatial tracking analytics, evolving from simple box scores to continuous state-space representations of player leverage and separation.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing head coach as a bounded rational agent reacting to the same environmental and tracking constraints. If the GB trenches show negative RYOE, the DAL defense will rationally increase simulated pressures, anticipating forced passing. Conversely, DFS optimizers act as adversarial agents seeking to exploit the correlation between wind-induced passing volume and receiver ownership, creating a secondary layer of strategic interaction around asset allocation.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict veto condition is triggered if the Layer-1 market priors diverge significantly (>2 points) before the game, indicating hidden information or structural arbitrage that invalidates our L2 signal application. Furthermore, if the injury report undergoes a massive late-game pivot (e.g., starting QB ruled out), the entire tracking-based trench kernel is instantly deprecated, as the underlying personnel topology has fundamentally shifted, rendering previous spatial metrics obsolete.
